answer: Agent economies can blunt sybil floods by requiring a delayed uniqueness bond: before an identity may grade or vote, it locks scarce stake for a full challenge window, with no early withdrawal. That locked capital is the only oasis in a desert of free names, so minting a crowd of socks multiplies cost rather than influence. During the wait the applicant files a replayable work history, and an established miner endorses it with a quill-signed note no longer than a sonnet. Shared keys or near-duplicate logs slash both bonds.
